OBITUARY REFERENCE
MR. CHAIRMAN : Hon. Members, I refer with profound sorrow to the passing
away of Shri B.B. Tiwari, a sitting Member of this House, on the 25th of April, 2012,
at the age of 70 years.
Born in October 1941, at Jamuni, District, Siddharth Nagar in Uttar Pradesh,
Shri Tiwari was educated at Shivpati Inter College, Shohratgarh, St. Andrew’s College,
Gorakhpur and Allahabad University, Allahabad.
An agriculturist, an advocate and a social worker, Shri Tiwari actively participated
in social, cultural and literary activities during his student days, and worked for the
upliftment and welfare of downtrodden sections of the society.
Shri Tiwari started his legislative career as a Member of the Sixth Lok Sabha in
1977. He was also Member of the Ninth and Eleventh Lok Sabha. He represented the
State of Uttar Pradesh in this House from December, 2006 to July, 2010, and again
from the 3rd April, 2012 till his sad demise.
In the passing away of Shri B.B. Tiwari, the country has lost a veteran
parliamentarian, and a noted social worker.
We deeply mourn the passing away of Shri B.B. Tiwari.
